description: Inbox item — something that needs a person: an outlier, a failed routine, a draft to approve. It says why, names the artifacts it came from, and moves new → triaged → resolved. An item may carry an action; approving it runs the action on the approver's own credential and records what it returned. Raised by Lumen's raise_item, or by a Timer whose run failed.

item.description: state (new, triaged, resolved), reason, evidence (artifact ids), optional action {artifact_id, operation, body}, optional source {artifact_id, kind}, history [{state, at, by, note}], outcome (what an approval returned). Moved by Lumen's set_item_state and approve_item
